children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions announced commercial availability of SARA Assess, enabling SARA to connect with Circadian Risk to continuously verify security controls and trigger corrective workflows.
SARA Assess commercially available now for pilots and full deployments, integrating SARA with Circadian Risk's physical risk platform.
Integration lets SARA check third-party systems (e.g., VMS), identify offline/obstructed cameras, update risk scores, and initiate corrective actions.
Marks SARA's first commercial third-party integration, creating a software-led entry point that doesn't require RAD hardware deployment.
SARA Assess is one of 15 active initiatives on the company's public product roadmap and will be demoed at GSX 2026 in Atlanta.
